name: Kara: Suzuna Hen
source:
Game unites "Kizuato" and "Koihime" motives.

This spring break main character returns home after a long absence. There he meets four female childhood friends. By playing with them he becomes aware of a past promise and a gap in his memory. Can his warmth dissolve ice inside hearts?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
游戏结合了“Kizuato”和“Koihime”的动机。

这个春假主角阔别已久的家乡。在那里，他遇到了四位儿时的女性朋友。通过与他们玩耍，他意识到过去的承诺和记忆中的空白。他的温暖能融化心中的冰吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
